build_ppo_networks_discrete: build a PPO agent network for discrete action environments using make_networks with an Atari environment spec
build_ppo_networks_continuous: build a PPO agent network for continuous action environments using make_continuous_networks with tanh Gaussian policy
create_inference_fn: create an inference function for a PPO actor using make_inference_fn with PPONetworks and evaluation mode
create_mvn_diag_ppo_networks: create a PPONetworks instance for diagonal multivariate normal policy using make_mvn_diag_ppo_networks with a Haiku network
create_tanh_normal_ppo_networks: create a PPONetworks instance for tanh squashed normal policy using make_tanh_normal_ppo_networks with a Haiku network
